description.text: Teaching Objects Non Chinese-native speakers; Chinese people from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan who want to improve their Mandarin level. Teaching Objectives We provide Chinese language courses for international students who are taught by our professional teachers teaching Chinese to foreigners. They train the students from the aspects of listening, speaking, reading and writing. To guarantee the teaching quality, we will divide the students into different classes from beginning, junior, middle and senior levels according to their Chinese language proficiency. The number of students in each class is strictly kept small. Study Time To study more than one term and less than 3 school years; enrollment in March and September each year; 18 weeks each term; 20 hours' school learning each week; 4 hours each day (From Monday to Friday). Types of the Class 2-10 students each class; organizing sightseeing to the historic spots and interest place; organizing various colorful cultural and sports activities attended by both foreigners and Chinese students concerning language learning; according to students’ wishes, overseas students can live with Chinese families. Main Courses Integrated Chinese, Spoken-Chinese, Listening, Reading, Writing, HSK Training course, Chinese Culture and Music, Tai Chi and Video Class.

duration.text: The Chinese Language Training Program at Hebei Finance University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1041 USD/per semester ￥ 7500 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Curriculum Vitae

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Applicants must Be in good health
